question: In a rectangle PQRS, if m∠QPR = 26°, then m∠SQR = ________.
solution:
**Given:**

∠QPR = 26°

**Concept Used:**

The angles are equal to the corresponding equal side of an isosceles triangle

**Calculations:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f9bcf6822e490a048ada6f6bbe179e046302e5f81a559462052a40c3f781362.png] 

As the diagonals are equal and they bisect each other at midpoint

⇒ so, SO = OR

In triangle OPQ

⇒ OP = OQ

⇒ so, ∠OPQ = ∠OQP = 26°

as we know, each angle of the rectangle is 90°

⇒ ∠Q = ∠OQP + ∠OQR

⇒ 90° = 26° + ∠OQR

⇒ ∠OQR = 90 - 26 = 64°

**⇒ Hence, The Required value is 64°**
